waiver.quote: This subsection does not apply to an action based on contract for which attorney fees are authorized under ORS 20.082.

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that
boundary.quote_limits: (4) No attorney at law or person other than the plaintiff and defendant and their witnesses shall appear on behalf of any party in litigation in the small claims department without the consent of the judge of the court.

plain-words.quote_longest: (2) Any judgment docketed before the effective date of this 1999 Act, including judgments docketed under the provisions of ORS 46.488 (1997 Edition), that did not become a lien on real property by reason of failure of the judgment creditor to file a lien certificate with the cour

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: (4)(a) If the defendant claims the right to a jury trial and does not prevail in the action, the court shall award to the plaintiff reasonable attorney fees incurred by the plaintiff in the action.
fair-exchange.quote_gets: (1) In addition to any other award, the prevailing party shall be entitled to a judgment for the small claims filing fees and service expenses paid by the party and the prevailing party fee provided for in ORS 20.190 (1)(c) or (2)(b).
